illustration_style: premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink editorial illustration
paper_rule: neutral ivory/off-white, not yellow, mustard, sepia, parchment, beige/tan dominant, coffee-stained, or heavy cream
line_quality: fine ink and pencil linework with natural variation, delicate sketch texture, and gentle crosshatching
background_style: soft minimal doorway or terrace environment fading into paper, with upper-middle negative space preserved for text
texture: visible paper grain, transparent watercolor blooms, dry-brush texture, tactile clothing and prop detail, soft faded edges
text_style: readable hand-drawn warm charcoal typography baked into the illustration, placed in upper-middle negative space with exact wording and line breaks
brandmark_rule: tiny low-contrast handwritten @a.storyof.two bottom-right as part of the artwork
composition_rules: same story scene continuity across slides
shawl readable but not oversized into a prop poster
avoid busy railings, heavy wind lines, or fabric folds competing with text
negative_style_rules: no glossy finish or harsh contrast
